description:
Black Forest Frozen Yogurt – Tart Cherries, Chocolate & Creamy Greek Yogurt! 🍫❄️🍒 

Craving something rich, refreshing, and a little indulgent? This Black Forest Frozen Yogurt combines dark cherries, chocolate, and tangy yogurt into a decadent frozen treat that’s surprisingly easy to make at home!

EDIT: I made some last minute changes after this version went too hard after day 2. I have adjusted the amounts below and it appears to be a little better. Although I adjusted the numbers, I am going to do this again in a week or two to really perfect it as i'm just not 100% happy with this one from day 2 onwards, the taste is AMAZING though!

EDIT 2: I'm getting really close to the required longetivy now, the taste is still perfect too!
EDIT 3 (31st May): I've changed most numbers below, this is now THE recipe to use, it's WONDEFUL and doesn't go too hard!

🥣 Ingredients EDITED 31st May 2025 :
240g Milk 3.5%MF
385g Yogurt 5%MF
85g Cream
185g Sugar
10g Invert Sugar
10g Vanilla Extract
3g Stabilizer
20g SMP

🕒 Timestamps
0:00 – Intro: Yoghurt vs Yogurt
0:18 – The yogurt to use
1:19 – Ingredients
2:33 – Prepping the base
3:47 – The vanilla extract
4:30 – The cherry stuff
7:38 – Churning and adding syrup and chocolate
8:46 – Scoop and test
9:43 – The end

🥣 This recipe features:
✔️ A creamy yogurt base with just the right tang
✔️ Rich, sweet-tart cherry swirls
✔️ Dark chocolate shavings for texture & depth
✔️ Lower fat, probiotic-rich goodness
✔️ Easy churn & no-churn options

This is your summer dessert upgrade – no cake needed!

👇 Have a favorite cherry or chocolate combo? Share it in the comments! And don’t forget to like 👍 and subscribe for more homemade frozen dessert recipes.

#FrozenYogurt #BlackForestDessert #CherryChocolate #HomemadeFrozenYogurt #HealthyDessert #IceCreamMaker #NoChurnIceCream #DessertRecipe
